description: Use this when a user wants a first-pass readiness check for French/EU pay transparency obligations before requesting a PariteCK demo. country and headcount are required: the tool rejects the call (rather than guessing) if they are missing or mis-named, so obligation applicability is never inferred from incomplete input.

country.description: Company country, for example France. Required.

hasCseReporting.description: Whether CSE/NAO reporting evidence is already assembled.

hasJobFamilies.description: Whether equivalent-value job families/categories are mapped.

hasPayrollExport.description: Whether payroll export or DSN data is available.

headcount.description: Approximate employee count (positive whole number). Required.

name: assess_readiness

appliesDirective2023970.description: The French transposition of Directive (UE) 2023/970 would apply.

campaigns.description: Last campaign under the current index, then the first one with seven indicators.

assumed.description: True when the date depends on a text not yet in force.

caveat.description: Decision-support caveat, to show with the answer.

interpretedInputs.description: The inputs as the tool understood them; missing booleans read as false.
